items.question: How is Cylosof priced?
items.answer: By the number of employees and the edition (cloud or on-prem). Request a demo and we will send a quote for your organisation.

items.question: Can it run inside our network?
items.answer: Yes. The on-prem edition runs on your servers inside your network and is built from the same code as the cloud edition. You install new versions when they are released.

items.question: Where is data stored in the cloud edition?
items.answer: The cloud edition runs in an UpCloud data centre in London. If your data has to stay inside your country or your own network, choose the on-prem edition.

items.question: Is any personal data sent to AI services?
items.answer: No. Names, email addresses and job titles never go to AI services. The tutor receives the lesson context and an anonymous ID only.

items.question: Which languages does it support?
items.answer: The interface works in 10 languages: Azerbaijani, English, Russian, Turkish, Romanian, Georgian, Ukrainian, German, French and Italian. Each employee picks their own.

items.question: Does it work on phones without an app store?
items.answer: Yes. Cylosof installs from the browser as a web app on any phone, and there is an Android app. Every lesson is designed for the phone first.

items.question: How long does rollout take?
items.answer: It depends on the edition and on how you add your staff (file import or your directory). We agree on the plan and the dates during the demo.

items.question: Can we use our own policy and branding?
items.answer: Yes. You can set your own acceptable use policy, attestation text, logo and colours. Custom lessons are agreed per project.

items.question: How do we prove completion to auditors?
items.answer: Every module ends with an attestation that stores the exact text each person confirmed. Department reports export to CSV, XLSX and PDF, and every certificate has a public page that verifies it.

items.question: Who is behind Cylosof?
items.answer: Cylosof is built in Azerbaijan by security practitioners. Every lesson is written and reviewed by a red team specialist.
